title: Seasonal Event Readiness Checklist Completion
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birthday:spend
| search item_type="checklist"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(completed="true")) as successful by _time event_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for seasonal readiness checklist items by event.
value: Checklist completion rate keeps small celebrations from slipping because of one forgotten setup step.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for seasonal readiness checklist items events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for seasonal readiness checklist items by event.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often seasonal readiness checklist items works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
